The zim iOS app, unsigned, for sideloading with SideStore or AltStore.

**Add the source once** and SideStore offers each new release:

```
https://zim.krondor.org/ios/sidestore.json
```

Or download `Zim.ipa` below and install it with SideStore.
Install steps: https://zim.krondor.org/docs/install/
